full_body_vs_pieces: Equipping a full-body item clears Upper and Lower slots (confirm in UI).
hat_vs_helmet: One head-gear item at a time per Head slot.

notes: Items are 3D meshes attached at named bone anchor points (socket/anchor per item).
Layered rendering: customization items render on top of the base model.
Customization is stored as a list of item IDs per slot per character.
UI: grid of items with 3D preview on the character model; purchased with in-game currency.
